title: Canon of the Twin Fog Courts
summary: A canon of two courts of fog that sit in judgment on a foe from either side and let the user pass between them as mist.

title: Treatise of the Azure Haze
summary: A treatise on a pale blue haze that holds the colour of high sky and lets the user vanish into it between one glance and the next.

title: The Hawk and Brume Mastery
summary: A mastery of the hawk that hides inside brume and drops from it onto one chosen foe with the cloud still round its wings.

title: Basin Dew and River Fog Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of dew collected in a basin and fog released down a river to carry the user and friends where they wish.

title: The Plateau Fog Canon
summary: A canon of broad level fog that spreads over open ground with no rise to break it and hides every body upon it.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Sworn Mist
summary: A treatise on a mist sworn to keep faith with the user and to betray any who break faith inside it.

title: The Bearing Through Fog Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of holding a true bearing through fog so thick that no eye or sense can find the way except the user's.

title: Manual of the Unwalled Mist
summary: A manual of a mist without an edge that drifts on the plateau wind and leaves no wall for a foe to find or strike.
